full_service_ready_byte_hit_rate.formula: sum(unique requested dependency resident bytes within each eligible request where full_service_ready=true) / sum(unique requested dependency resident bytes within every eligible request)
full_service_ready_byte_hit_rate.shared_base_semantics: one base object is counted once within one request; a distinct request counts its required base once again; lookup rows and resident inventory never add bytes
full_service_ready_byte_hit_rate.partial_readiness: zero numerator bytes for the whole request
full_service_ready_byte_hit_rate.missing_size: primary value null with partial availability and explicit coverage

transfer_mb_per_request.other_typed_transfer: reported separately and excluded from primary
